preview_heading: Kings meet Tridents in Gros Islet
preview: Saint Lucia Kings face Barbados Tridents in CPL 2026 Match 9 at Daren Sammy Cricket Ground. The match is scheduled for Sun 16 Aug at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: Roston Chase and Matthew Forde anchor the returning group, joined by Jewel Andrew and a fresh Saint Lucian pathway that includes McKenny Clarke. Barbados return to the Tridents identity and national colours in 2026, with Gudakesh Motie, Sherfane Rutherford and Brandon King among the senior Caribbean core. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
